==Description==
The '''Star Creaeggtor Cannon 9001''' was a gear published to the Roblox catalog on the 5th of April, 2020, specifically for the Roblox event, [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] As Tower Defense Simulator was part of this event, this gear had some use in the game. You can no longer use this gear in Tower Defense Simulator.

==Usage==
Using the '''Star Creaeggtor Cannon 9001''', you could shoot out the [[w:c:Roblox:Catalog:Star Creaeggtor Egg|Star Creaeggtor Egg]] for all players to obtain.

==Trivia==
*Only players in the Roblox Video Star Program and Quality Assurance Testers can own this gear.
*The '''Star Creaeggtor Cannon 9001''' could've only be used in the Tower Defense Simulator lobby between the 6th of April, 2020, and the 29th of April, 2020.
**After 29 April 2020, the '''Star Creaeggtor Cannon 9001''' could no longer be used, although the [[Spring 2020 Event]] still continued.
*The '''Star Creaeggtor Cannon 9001''' can be used in other games that allow for it, though its primary function is now depreciated.
*On the Roblox website, the 3D view of the '''Star Creaeggtor Cannon 9001''' is glitched.
